notes.subject: מוזר/ונכרי
notes.rationale: Tupela tok — 'man i no save' na 'man bilong hap narapela' — i tok olsem wanpela pasin, klostu wankain mining; Tok Pisin i ken lukim narapela tok tasol.

notes.subject: ol
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat 'ol' namel, tasol Tok Pisin i needim 'ol' long 'ol brata' na 'ol pikinini man'.

translation: Man i no save long ol mi kamap long ol brata bilong mi, na man bilong hap narapela long ol pikinini man bilong mama bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: man i no save long ol
